findings.title: Shard skew is strongly supported but is not a strict established cause of the timeout
evidence: Shard 1 has 931969ms of unique reported file duration and shard 2 has 647242ms. Assigning the shared property-file occurrence adversarially gives a correct 268089-301365ms reported-duration excess.
Shard 2 completed in 1876180ms, leaving 223820ms below the 2100000ms wrapper cap.
The runner sets fileParallelism=false and maxWorkers=1 (tools/test/run_vitest_balanced.mjs:109-112), so completed files within a worker do not overlap.

However, Vitest's file-line durations correspond chiefly to test execution, while completed-worker wall time also includes transform, collection, environment, prepare, and other overhead. Shard 2 reports 1497590ms tests within 1876180ms wall time (718 stdout lines 1704-1707). Shard 1 has no terminal summary for those categories.

Therefore comparing shard 1 minus shard 2 summed file durations directly with shard 2's wall-clock margin is not a strict wall-time lower bound. Per-shard overhead, cache effects, collection cost, and the 17 missing files' start/runtime state remain unmeasured.
findings.required_correction: Replace 'established bounded cause' and 'sufficient explanation' with 'strongly supported primary measured contributor' or 'plausible sufficient explanation'. Preserve that no specific hang, deadlock, contention mechanism, terminal file, or ordinary-tail completion was established.

findings.title: Native preservation is referenced, not freshly rehashed file-by-file by 728
findings.evidence: 728 freshly records the hashes of retained 703, retained 712, and the 720 native-inventory file, and states file_count=31. Its inventory does not contain a fresh 728 hash pass over each of the 31 native files. The accurate claim is that the retained 31-file 720 inventory remains referenced unchanged.

verified_facts.run_outcome: 718 timed out at 2100000ms with child/wrapper/cleanup 1/124/0; full-suite acceptance remains unmet.
verified_facts.positive_control: The three completed shards total 1024 file executions, 10152 passed tests, and 30 skipped tests. The deliberate 529ms nested failing fixture is expected by and contained within its passing 13/13 parent harness, so it is not a genuine native failure.
verified_facts.unfinished_shard: Shard 1 has 325 observed completion paths of 342 planned and 17 completion gaps; the 74-file serial lane was not reached because the runner awaits every parallel worker before starting it (tools/test/run_vitest_balanced.mjs:207-221).
verified_facts.shared_property_file: tests/sector_partition_buildCorpsFrontSectors_integration.test.ts completed once in each of four workers at 836608, 845596, 850341, and 853246ms, about 39.8-40.6% of the cap. These are four shard-indexed suite executions; retained evidence does not prove identical case-data ownership across copies.
verified_facts.planner: The planner defaults unmeasured files to 1000ms and greedily balances declared weights (tools/test/test_suite_inventory.mjs:35-65). The six largest shard-1 underweights sum to 615382ms; five used the 1000ms default. Retained 602/710 logs independently show the same named slow families recurring.
verified_facts.missing_files: All 17 completion gaps are jsdom files; one source uses fake timers and the scan found no named child-process/server/listener token. This is source-shape context only: it proves neither that a file started nor that no hang or leak occurred.
verified_facts.protected_pins: 728 records passing hashes for emit.ts, engine_health_thresholds.json, C telemetry, and D telemetry at the required expected values.
verified_facts.historical_status: Overall NO-GO remains unchanged. No acceptance threshold, historical gate, telemetry gate, campaign gate, test selection, timeout, shard count, or floor is retired.

causal_assessment.measured: Large planner error and shard-1 reported-duration skew are established.
causal_assessment.inference: That skew can plausibly account for the missed 35-minute window without invoking a hang and is the strongest retained explanation.
causal_assessment.unknown: Exact terminal/in-flight file, shard-1 overhead categories, execution order/cache state, resource contention, blocked handles, and whether the 17 missing files started.

smallest_next_action.now: Correct only the causal wording in the closeout synthesis; no new execution is needed to preserve the bounded retained finding.
smallest_next_action.cheapest_optional_analysis: Before any run, recompute a candidate partition offline from retained 718 durations with conservative sensitivity for the 17 unknown files and explicit per-worker overhead. This can test whether known planner underweights are practically actionable, but cannot identify the terminal file or prove the timeout cause.
smallest_next_action.if_exact_cause_is_required: Seek owner authorization for one preserved replay of the exact 718 shard-1 membership with per-file start and finish timestamps and unchanged test code and worker semantics. Stop on a bounded per-file budget breach or the shard terminal summary. This is a diagnostic replay, not a full-suite acceptance run.
